_meta.title: GridWise — Edge Case Test Pack
_meta.purpose: Additional adversarial and boundary inputs for testing LLM interpretation, deterministic directive validation, directive application, optimization feasibility, and schedule replay.
important: These cases intentionally do not include reference hourly schedules because equivalent optimal schedules are valid.
expected_directive_interpretation contains only the semantic ground truth needed to test note interpretation.
Run every input through the same production POST /optimize-energy pipeline.
Do not hard-code these note strings; use them to test paraphrase and boundary robustness.
